_comment: Dated provider prices, USD per million tokens. AI spec §3.
This is DATA, not configuration and not a tunable: every row records what a
human read on a vendor's published page on `verified_on`. Correcting a price
is a data change, which is what it is -- the same reasoning that makes
`adopt_detect`'s archetype rules YAML rather than Python.
These model names are price-table KEYS. Nothing selects a model from this
file; `ADOPT_MODEL` is the only thing that chooses one (AI spec §2).
